narrative.summaryIntro:
The Meenakshi Amman Temple (Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple) in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, is a historic temple dedicated to the goddess Meenakshi, a form of Parvati, and her consort Sundareswarar, a form of Shiva. Unusually among major Hindu temples, the goddess is the principal deity and is worshipped first.

The temple's fourteen gopurams, sculpted Hall of a Thousand Pillars, and the annual Meenakshi Thirukalyanam (celestial wedding) festival during Chithirai make it one of the most visited temples in India and the heart of the ancient city of Madurai.
